flags.title: UK leads way in disrupting shadowy Russian sanctions evasion network
flags.summary: Chancellor calls on allies to step up their pressure on Russia and sets out new action to stop Putin evading sanctions to fund his illegal war.

flags.title: Labour’s new housing model comes from California’s backyards
flags.summary: A quarter of all homes approved in California in 2025 were so-called granny flats, according to analysis.

flags.title: Upfront help cuts placement costs for healthcare students
flags.summary: From 2026/27, eligible healthcare students can get travel and accommodation costs upfront, easing financial pressure and supporting rural placements.

flags.title: Drones, Patriots and cash for Ukraine in the spotlight as EU ministers gather in Ireland
flags.summary: Good morning. It’s Mared Gwyn delivering your Tuesday newsletter from Brussels. We start today by crossing over to quaint County Wicklow on Ireland’s east coast – an unusual backdrop for talks on the security and defence threats spilling beyond Europe’s eastern flank.

flags.title: What does Iceland’s “No” vote mean for the EU’s enlargement policy?
flags.summary: Iceland won’t reopen EU membership negotiations after 58.2 percent voted against in Saturday’s referendum. Does this challenge whether the EU can still attract stable, wealthy democracies for reasons beyond finances?
